text:
marta-sales: Acme POC blocked - SCIM returns 403 domain_not_allowed when provisioning into Dedicated pool. Any quick fixes?

devin-solutions: usually a verified_domains mismatch. IdP sending user@eu.acme.com but tenant only has acme.com.

tom-acme: we sent eng emails from our IdP. can change mapping but need exact claim name.

ali-infra: short options: 1) have IdP map the SAML `mail` claim to the base domain (emails[0].value) so SCIM matches, or 2) we add the subdomain to tenant verified_domains (requires legal + audit).

susan-sec: if infra adds a domain we need explicit approval and an audit trail. alternative: create a scoped provisioning key (scope: scim:users.create) with 12h TTL and log usage for onboarding.

marta-sales: they need POC live by EOD. can we manually create 3 admin users if legal signs off?

deploy-bot: [audit] manual provisioning request: create 3 admin users for tenant `acme-tenant-456` by marta-sales. status: pending (legal + infra).

tom-acme: we'll try mapping `mail` -> emails[0].value now and retest in ~20m.

devin-solutions: if still 403 paste the exact error body. sample expected error: {"status":403,"error":"domain_not_allowed","message":"user domain eu.acme.com not permitted for tenant"}.

marta-sales: thanks all, scheduling a 20-min IdP mapping call now.
